listing.name: Virtua Fighter 3 (Virtua Fighter 3 Recomp)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for Virtua Fighter 3 Recomp; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream reports bounded interpreter comparisons and matches. Online-preview release conflicts with README's online-not-yet status; broader coverage Unknown. PowerPC translates at launch via SLJIT, not static-only pipeline. Latest tag is online-preview while README online says not yet. Windows Wine only and Intel Mac untried; resolve release/README mismatch. Upstream platforms: macOS Apple Silicon, Linux/Steam Deck and Windows packages. Windows tested under Wine; Intel Macs untried. Original data: Arcade Model 3 Virtua Fighter 3 MAME vf3.zip Revision D. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
